description: Assign one of the conference's reviewers to review one submission. Use it when the user is distributing papers to their programme committee. This EMAILS the reviewer to tell them they have a paper to review, so confirm the pairing with the user before calling. Get the submissionId from list_submissions and make sure the person is already a reviewer (add_reviewer does that). The platform will refuse the assignment — and you should relay the reason rather than retrying — if the reviewer has a declared conflict of interest with that submission, is its submitter, is one of its co-authors, is already assigned to it, or has hit their maximum review load. Those are facts about the people involved, not problems with your request, so the answer is to suggest a different reviewer. It will also refuse if the conference has no review stage configured yet — that is set up in the dashboard under the Review settings, and no assignment can exist before it. Requires the user to be an admin of that conference, and an OAuth connection rather than an API key. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

reviewerId.description: The reviewer's user id. They must already be a reviewer for this conference.
